summary: A customer carries an unfamiliar brand into a store that sells the same kind of drink.
realLife: Oregon required larger stores to redeem covered beverage types they sold even when another store had sold that brand.
inGame: The bill catalog supplies the bottle-deposit question. needs: store size and brand acceptance rule.

turns.what: The clerk pays the refund after identifying the beverage category.
turns.pulledBy: The store meets the size threshold and sells the beverage type.
turns.writesBack: The unfamiliar brand gets a redemption entry.

turns.what: If the cross-brand rule ends, the clerk checks which brands the store must still accept.
turns.pulledBy: The cross-brand duty expired before the container was presented.
turns.writesBack: The clerk checks any surviving acceptance duty.
